outcome: Production smoke now reuses one shared Chrome host
owner_impact: The full production smoke breadth is preserved, but active surface checks no longer launch seven independent Chrome processes. Each check runs in an isolated browser context under one shared host, reducing startup duplication and the Chrome-launch failure mode that caused the previous red run.
remaining_action: No owner action is required for the smoke refactor. Next project action: complete issue #278 OAuth cutover once the correct Supabase platform login is established.
technical_evidence: Every active manifest smoke must use smoke-browser-harness.mjs; a regression test rejects future smoke scripts that launch Chrome directly.
Each surface receives an isolated browser context/target, preserving storage/auth/test isolation.
All existing surface assertions and hard per-check timeouts remain in place; production completion still requires green exact-candidate smoke.
